abstractions.name: SUPPORT_MASS_CAP_NECESSARY_PRUNER

contract.input: nonnegative exceptional coordinates, exact exceptional mass, exact support lower bound, and exact remaining support capacity
contract.operation: combine mass/support/capacity arithmetic into a necessary inequality and reject only assignments violating that inequality
contract.output: zero-loss necessary finite pruning on the source-compatible population

abstractions.scope_firewall: Stage32 constants S10,M10,38,d,g,e and the measured 49.7089% saving are provenance, not reusable universal constants.

abstractions.name: AUTHORITY_PRESERVING_FILTERED_RANDOM_ACCESS_ADAPTER

contract.input: an authoritative canonical ranker, an exact audited predicate, and the exact survivor/rejection partition
contract.operation: construct a secondary survivor rank/unrank coordinate while retaining a reversible bridge to canonical rank
contract.output: random access to survivors without replacing completeness authority or changing canonical order

abstractions.scope_firewall: secondary execution identity never becomes completeness authority merely because it is bijective on survivors

abstractions.name: FAIL_CLOSED_FILTERED_EXECUTION_COMPLETENESS_WALL

contract.input: source-locked manifest membership, audited partition/ranker contracts, work-unit bounds, and an independently registered exact leaf-certificate verifier
contract.operation: bind all source identities into work-unit identity and refuse COMPLETE if any leaf-verification contract is absent or mismatched
contract.output: structural exact-cover evidence separated from numerical-leaf completeness

abstractions.scope_firewall: structural interval coverage alone cannot discharge production leaves or release numerical completeness

abstractions.name: EXACT_POST_FILTER_PRIORITY_CENSUS

contract.input: an exact finite stratum population and an exact survivor counter
contract.operation: stream deterministic per-stratum counts, hashes, order statistics and small-bucket summaries without materializing the whole survivor set
contract.output: a reproducible priority ledger for choosing mathematically cheap next strata

abstractions.scope_firewall: priority information is not new pruning and gives no leaf/theorem credit

abstractions.name: SATURATED_SUPPORT_RIGIDITY_REDUCER

contract.input: n nonnegative integral coordinates with exact total mass n and a certified support lower bound at least n
contract.operation: use support<=n and integrality to force every coordinate positive, then exact mass to force every coordinate equal to one
contract.output: collapse of the exceptional branch to a unique all-ones vector

abstractions.scope_firewall: Stage32 n=48 and the four e=48 strata are provenance only; source audit is required before credit-bearing reuse

abstractions.name: EXACT_FUNCTIONAL_AUGMENTATION_LADDER_FOR_LATTICE_OBSTRUCTION

contract.input: an exact integral lattice image, a target family, and source-derived linear functionals or aggregate conservation laws
contract.operation: test baseline HNF membership, add exact independent functionals when baseline is too weak, detect rationally dependent functionals, and convert forced derived quantities into subsequent inequality/nonnegativity tests
contract.output: exact necessary rejection when augmentation adds information, plus anti-loop evidence when a proposed functional is dominated or dependent

abstractions.scope_firewall: HNF feasibility is not a SAT/effectivity witness; N280 rejection remains provisional until its N260 dependency and its own audit boundary are satisfied

abstractions.name: SYMBOLIC_FREE_AXIS_EXACT_UNSAT_BLOCK_PARTITION

contract.input: a finite outer branch rank, one independent free coordinate retained symbolically, and an exact leaf solver
contract.operation: partition only the outer branch into exact blocks while keeping the free axis symbolic through every leaf check
contract.output: exact UNSAT closure for each certified block without enumerating the free axis

abstractions.scope_firewall: the retained g1-d008/e4 constants and block endpoints are local provenance; transfer to other strata requires a source-model adapter

abstractions.name: FINITE_STABILIZER_CAPACITY_PARITY_ELIMINATOR

contract.input: a complete finite stabilizer/branch candidate set with exact capacity data and an exact residual parity table
contract.operation: apply coarse capacity elimination first and an exhaustive parity discriminator to the remaining finite candidates
contract.output: a forced stabilizer/branch class on the certified finite population

abstractions.scope_firewall: finite branch forcing does not imply global geometric existence or Stage closure

abstractions.name: NORMALIZATION_CONDUCTOR_EVEN_CORRECTION_COUPLER

contract.input: normalization/cover data with branch divisor and conductor correction supported at the same base points
contract.operation: use Disc(pi)=Br+2A and degree accounting to couple local singularity/conductor mass to ramification with the required even correction
contract.output: exact necessary local/global degree coupling

abstractions.scope_firewall: the numerical degree shadows 4036/4084 are source provenance and the coupling is necessary, not an existence theorem

abstractions.name: CELLULAR_SMITH_COKERNEL_ASSEMBLY_OBSTRUCTION

contract.input: an exact finite cellular/gluing assembly model with an integral boundary or incidence map
contract.operation: enumerate legal assemblies and compute Smith normal form/cokernel classes for the induced obstruction map
contract.output: exact zero/nonzero and torsion-order obstruction classification for the finite assembly population

abstractions.scope_firewall: the 6144x4 population and order-two outcome are Stage32 provenance; another problem must source-lock its own cellular model

abstractions.name: SCOPE_IDENTITY_GATED_GEOMETRIC_EXCLUSION_PACKAGE

contract.input: an audited exclusion on source population A and a separately audited identity/transport adapter from A to target population B
contract.operation: verify exact population semantics before composing the exclusion with the adapter
contract.output: target-scope exclusion with both source theorem and population identity preserved as independent source locks

abstractions.scope_firewall: similar naming or equal cardinality cannot substitute for the audited population adapter

abstractions.name: PARTIAL_MARKING_WITH_RESIDUAL_TORSOR_CERTIFICATE

contract.input: a finite marking torsor/group action plus source-derived structural invariants
contract.operation: enumerate admissible markings and orbit fibers, identify the structural quotient fixed by the data, and record the residual phase/torsor ambiguity exactly
contract.output: the strongest source-bound partial marking together with a certificate of what absolute marking cannot yet be selected

abstractions.scope_firewall: a gauge representative or structural P/Q split is not an absolute cyclic phase or retained W-line

abstractions.name: WEIGHTED_LOCAL_DEBT_AND_RAMIFICATION_SPLIT_ACCOUNTING

contract.input: a weighted local pole/zero ledger and factorwise ramification support variables
contract.operation: balance divisor degree, split nonnode ramification into exact support contributions, and algebraically compare aggregate Riemann-Hurwitz equations with factorwise equations
contract.output: residual debt requirements plus an explicit no-double-counting certificate when an aggregate equation is dependent

abstractions.scope_firewall: dependent total-degree identities provide no independent saving; Stage32 O266 coefficients are provenance only

abstractions.name: FINITE_NODE_ACTION_AND_FIELD_INVOLUTION_ORBIT_DIAGNOSTIC

contract.input: a canonical finite-node model, an explicit automorphism action, a retained class, and a field/Galois involution
contract.operation: reconstruct the finite action group and its orbit, apply the field involution to the class, and test membership in the retained automorphism orbit
contract.output: an exact finite diagnostic separating geometric automorphism orbit from field-conjugate class

abstractions.scope_firewall: outside-orbit is not by itself a descent obstruction or arithmetic nonexistence theorem

abstractions.name: CANONICAL_GEOMETRIC_IDENTITY_RECONSTRUCTION_STACK

contract.input: exact source-model equations/Jacobian data, explicit model renaming, runtime indices, and canonical projective fingerprints
contract.operation: reconstruct singular points, verify equations/Jacobian/distinctness, identify equivalent model coordinates, and map runtime objects to collision-free canonical geometric identities
contract.output: a source-locked runtime-index to canonical-object adapter independent of incidental enumeration order

abstractions.scope_firewall: runtime order itself is never semantic identity; fingerprints and source-model equations remain load-bearing

abstractions.name: FAIL_CLOSED_CLAIM_DAG_PROMOTION_WORKFLOW

contract.input: immutable claim cores, explicit PROVES/DOES_NOT_PROVE edges, exact source locks, cross-scope adapters and audit states
contract.operation: permit dependency promotion only through declared asymmetric transitions and fail closed on scope or audit mismatch
contract.output: a claim DAG in which local PASS cannot silently become parent/MAIN authority

abstractions.scope_firewall: workflow correctness does not itself grant mathematical credit

abstractions.name: BOUNDED_ROUTE_FAMILY_EXHAUSTION_LEDGER

contract.input: a frozen finite route family, exact per-route status, and named missing adapters/reopen conditions
contract.operation: classify each route as qualified, blocked, inapplicable, duplicate or otherwise bounded and retain exact reopen prerequisites
contract.output: a reproducible no-recharge ledger for the frozen route family

abstractions.scope_firewall: zero qualified routes in the frozen family is not proof that no mathematically distinct route exists

abstractions.name: VALUATION_SEPARATED_SECTION_LOWER_BOUND_CERTIFIER

contract.input: explicit divisor-theoretic sections with source-locked valuation data
contract.operation: use valuation separation to prove linear independence from an already constructed section subspace
contract.output: a certified lower bound on section-space dimension

abstractions.scope_firewall: dimension lower bound is not full H0 reconstruction and does not imply a genus-one member or effectivity beyond the certified sections

abstractions.name: LABELLED_NODE_SUPPORT_SPAN_IMPORT_ADAPTER

contract.input: an external labelled-node support/span object, an exact runtime-to-node identity adapter, and a separately typed exceptional-pairing bridge
contract.operation: validate labels, population identity and pairing semantics before importing the support/span statement into the current target
contract.output: a typed current-target infrastructure interface with no automatic mathematical conclusion

abstractions.scope_firewall: external node-support data cannot be consumed through label coincidence alone

abstractions.name: EQUIVARIANT_QUOTIENT_NONINVARIANCE_TO_COMMUTATOR_CHAIN

contract.input: an orbit-sum class on a resolved model, the exceptional-span quotient, an equivariant finite cover with injective rational pullback, and the exact hypothetical carrier/correspondence interface
contract.operation: prove stabilizer noninvariance after blow-down, descend equivariant pullback to the quotient, use injectivity to lift noninvariance, then translate to conditional correspondence noncommutation
contract.output: conditional commutator/non-scalarity obstruction under the exact carrier hypothesis

abstractions.scope_firewall: the withdrawn strict-transform multiplicity bridge must never be revived; without a recoverable hostile re-audit receipt this remains promotion-blocked

abstractions.name: SOURCE_BOUND_ORBIT_CHARACTER_WITH_ABSOLUTE_MARKING_FIREWALL

contract.operation: evaluate orbit profiles, identify an abstract character direction through retained semantic anchors, and preserve the residual marking torsor explicitly
